# EvInput

> A single-line text input for collecting short free-form values. It supports leading/trailing icons, validation messaging, and multiple interaction states.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:input` |
| Layer | Atom (`src/atoms`) |
| Import | `import { EvInput } from 'evoq-ui'` |
| Template tag | `<EvInput>` or `<ev-input>` |
| Source | `src/atoms/input/EvInput.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the inner `<input class="ev-input__control">`, not the root |

## Example

```vue
<EvInput
  placeholder="PT Contoh Sejahtera"
  label="Nama vendor"
/>
```

_The exact snippet the playground simulator copies for this component (`playground/simulator-demos.ts`)._

## Design guidance

From the Figma page **Input**, frame `4680:3577` (Input Field). These rules are binding. Names in them are Figma's - the Vue API is the tables above.

### When to use

- Use to collect short, single-line text such as name, email, or code.
- Use a leading icon to signal the input's purpose (e.g. search, user).
- Use a trailing icon for clear/reveal actions.
- Use validation text to guide correction inline.
- Use the disabled state when the field is not editable in the current context.

### When not to use

- Don't use for long, multi-line text  →  use InputTextArea (`evoq-ui:textarea`).
- Don't use for choosing from a fixed set  →  use InputDropdown (`evoq-ui:input-dropdown`).
- Don't use for dates or times  →  use InputDate (`evoq-ui:input-date`) / InputTime (`evoq-ui:input-time`).
- Don't place critical instructions only in the placeholder.

### Do

- Always pair the field with a visible Title/label.
- Keep placeholder text as an example, not an instruction.
- Show validation text close to the field, on error.
- Use a consistent icon size (16px) for leading/trailing icons.

### Don't

- Rely on placeholder alone as the label.
- Use red borders without an explanatory validation message.
- Mix icon sizes or styles across fields.
- Disable a field without making the reason clear.

## Contract

- Only the props, slots and events above exist on `EvInput`; anything not listed is not part of its API.
- An attribute that is not a prop (`class`, `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the inner `<input class="ev-input__control">`, not the root.
- Import it by name from `evoq-ui`; styles come once from `evoq-ui/style.css`.
- Refer to it by id `evoq-ui:input` - the id stays the same if the component moves layer.
